_comment: GOLDEN — sanity/schemas/documents/showExhibitorInfo.ts, plus the object types it composes.
Pinned singleton, fixed _id 'showExhibitorInfo' (the project convention: _id === schema type name).
SHAPE RATIONALE. Research Section 9 found a near-universal pattern: every established show
separates exhibitor information into distinct documents — registration instructions, the class
schedule, rules/eligibility, awards — rather than one blob. Research Section 10 found SAOC's
current state is the opposite: a single unstructured `nationalShow.exhibitorStages` portableText
field. This schema is that separation, expressed as one typed field per topic.
WHAT THIS SCHEMA DELIBERATELY DOES NOT CONTAIN:
- No `datetime` field for any exhibitor deadline. See showExhibitorDate below.
- No class list. Show classes already render on /national-show from the `showClass` type.
- No judging criteria. SAOC judging standards already live on /judging.
- No online entry submission fields. Out of scope per the mission; needs its own
data-handling decision the council has not been asked for.

fields._group: STATUS LABELS — the wording of every marker, editable in one place
fields.name: pendingLabel
fields.description: Shown on blocks the committee still has to supply.

fields.name: keyDatesNote
fields.description: Sits above the dates table. Must make clear none of these are set yet.

fields.name: keyDates
fields.description: Entry closes, staging, judging, show days, removal.

fields._group: ENTRY FORM — F3. A committee-supplied PDF, NOT an online submission form.
fields.name: entryFormHeading
entryFormFile
fields.description: Upload the committee's entry form PDF. Until one exists, leave this empty — the page renders an honest 'to be published' state rather than a dead link.
fields._note: NOT seeded. There is no entry form. Seeding a placeholder file would be the exact harm this mission is about.

fields.name: entryFormUrl
fields.description: Only if the form is hosted elsewhere. Leave empty if you uploaded a file above.

fields.name: entryFormPendingNote
fields.description: Shown when neither a file nor a URL is set. This is the honest empty state — it must never render as a link.
fields.seeded: The entry form for the 19th National Show has not been published yet. When the show committee releases it, it will be available for download here. In the meantime, contact the council if you intend to exhibit.

fields._group: CONTENT SECTIONS — one per research section. Each is an `exhibitorSection` object.
fields.name: entryProcess
classes
fields._note: Points at the class list already on /national-show. Must NOT restate the classes.

fields.name: judging
fields._note: Points at /judging for standards. Must NOT restate the judging criteria.

fields.name: permits
fields._note: CITES, provincial movement, indigenous species. Status is ALWAYS 'question' at seed. This block states no requirement — it asks.

fields._group: OPEN QUESTIONS — research Section 12, as structured data rather than prose
fields.name: questionsHeading
openQuestions
fields.description: Things the research could not establish. These render on the page so an exhibitor knows what is genuinely undecided, and so the committee can see its own to-do list.

fields._group: CROSS-LINKS — editable labels for the two links we must not duplicate content behind
fields.name: judgingLinkLabel

_note: No status field here on purpose. Status for fixed singleton blocks lives centrally on
`confirmations`, keyed by the same field name. Two sources of status would drift.

fields.name: dateNote
fields._eg: To be set by the show committee

fields.name: detail
fields._eg: What the exhibitor has to have done by then

_WHY_dateNote_IS_A_STRING_NOT_A_DATETIME: This is the single most important type decision in the schema.
A `datetime` field must hold a date. There is no such thing as an honestly-empty datetime
that still renders as a row in a dates table. Seeding one would mean inventing a staging
date — and research Section 1 is explicit: 'specific lead time for entry deadlines varies
from same-week on-site registration to multi-week advance cutoffs — no consistent interval
across shows. Do not bake in a specific number of days.'
An invented datetime is also the most dangerous possible field on this page, because a date
renders as a date. A reader scanning for a deadline will read '4 September 2027' as fact no
matter what badge sits beside it. A string reading 'To be set by the show committee' cannot
COST, ACCEPTED: no sorting, no countdown, no .ics export from these dates. When the
committee supplies real dates, adding a parallel optional `date: datetime` is a small
follow-up — and at that point the values are real, so it is safe. Doing it now is not.

fields.name: question
fields._note: Phrased as a question TO the committee.

fields.name: context
fields._note: Why we are asking — what the research did and did not find. This is what stops the question reading as ignorance.

_note: Deliberately NOT the visitor stream's confirmationStatuses.ts — that object's thirteen
block names are visitor-specific and the file is in flight in another stream.

showExhibitorInfoQuery.name: showExhibitorInfoQuery
showExhibitorInfoQuery._note: Must project EVERY field above. A field in the schema that the query drops renders as nothing — the exact false-green class this project has hit three times.
